nodes.text:
#India has recently reported its 1st cases of Human Metapneumovirus (#HMPV), with 2 cases identified in #Bengaluru, #Karnataka, & 1 in #Ahmedabad, #Gujarat.

All detected cases are in infants, with the patients in Bengaluru showing symptoms of bronchopneumonia but now recovering.
